info.name: Trendr API
info.description:
Full-surface collection for the Trendr API (43 paths, 53 operations).

Prerequisites: a seeded and scored stack, Mailpit for the magic-link flow, and the seed admin API key in adminApiKey.

Run order: 00 Health & meta → 01 Auth → 02 Public → 03 Me → 04 Admin → 05 Negative. Folders 06 Manual and 99 Destructive are opt-in.

Auth: the Me folder uses Bearer {{accessToken}}; the Admin folder uses X-API-Key {{adminApiKey}}; cookie writes carry x-requested-with: trendr. Postman’s cookie jar holds dt_refresh — use localhost consistently, not 127.0.0.1.

See docs/postman/README.md for setup, variables and Newman commands.

request.description: Process liveness. No dependencies are probed.

exec: pm.test('all dependencies are ready', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('ready'); pm.expect(body.checks.db).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(body.checks.redis).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(body.checks.migrations).to.eql('ok'); });

request.description: Database, Redis and migration-journal readiness. Returns 503 when degraded.

exec: pm.test('set metricsToken to assert a scrape', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 401]));

request.description: Guarded by METRICS_TOKEN, not a JWT. Set the collection variable metricsToken to assert a 200; without it the endpoint returns 401.
The generated OpenAPI 3.1 document; the drift guard compares it with this collection.

exec: pm.test('accepted without leaking whether the address exists', () => pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(true));

request.description: Creates (or reuses) a user for the generated address and sends the link through the configured SMTP server. Each run uses a fresh address because the limit is 3 links per email per hour.

exec: pm.test('a message exists for ' + email, () => pm.expect(match, 'No message yet. Is Mailpit running and SMTP_URL pointed at it?').to.be.ok);

request.description: Local-only: queries Mailpit for the newest message addressed to userEmail and stores its ID. Fails clearly when Mailpit or SMTP is not running.

exec: pm.test('message contains a magic-link token', () => pm.expect(match, 'No /auth/verify?token= link in the message').to.be.ok);

request.description: Reads the message body and extracts the token from the /auth/verify?token= link.

exec: pm.test('signed in as the generated user', () => pm.expect(body.user.email.toLowerCase()).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail')).toLowerCase()));

request.description: Exchanges the one-time token for a 15-minute access JWT and sets the httpOnly dt_refresh cookie in Postman’s cookie jar.
Bearer-authenticated profile read; proves the token works before the Me folder runs.

header.description: CSRF header required for cookie-authenticated writes

request.description: Cookie-authenticated write: requires the x-requested-with: trendr CSRF header. Rotates the refresh token and returns a new access token.

exec: pm.test('returns a ranked board', () => pm.expect(body.data.length, 'No board data. Seed and trigger a score first (POST /v1/admin/score or pnpm worker:score).').to.be.greaterThan(0));

request.description: Saves the first two items, the scoring run ID, the ETag and the next cursor for later requests. Requires a scored board: run a seed and a score first.

exec: pm.test('every row is a GitHub repo', () => body.data.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.item.source).to.eql('github')));

query.description: Only items first seen in the window

request.description: Exercises the scope/window/kind/newOnly filters.
Returns a 302 to the item detail; Postman follows it. The final body is the item saved from the trending board.

header.description: ETag saved by the previous request

request.description: Repeats the detail request with If-None-Match; a matching body hash returns 304 with no body.

exec: pm.test('echoes the item and metric', () => { pm.expect(String(body.itemId)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('itemId'))); pm.expect(body.metric).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('counts every source', () => { for (const source of ['github', 'npm', 'pypi', 'huggingface', 'arxiv', 'mcp']) pm.expect(body.items).to.have.property(source); });
pm.test('applies the new name', () => pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('Postman watchlist (renamed)'));
pm.test('returns the watchlist and its items', () => { pm.expect(body.watchlist.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('watchlistId')); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Idempotent; also promotes the item to the hot tier.
The full dt_live_… key is returned exactly once; it is stored in the secret collection variable createdApiKey.
Overrides the folder bearer auth with X-API-Key; proves the key works before it is revoked.
Scores every source; each job is queued independently.
Uses the newest run from the previous request. When the runs list is empty, adminRunId stays 0 and this asserts the 404.

exec: pm.test('returns a DLQ page', () => { pm.expect(body.jobs).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.page).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('returns the queue and job', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.queue).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.jobId).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Uses the newest failed job from the previous request. When the DLQ is empty, dlqJobId stays 0 and this asserts the 404.

exec: pm.test('no second dead-letter job returns 404', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

request.description: Deletes the second failed job from the DLQ list, because the retry above consumes the first. With fewer than two jobs, dlqJobId2 stays 0 and this asserts the 404.

exec: pm.test('returns API counters and buckets', () => { pm.expect(body.api).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.buckets).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: User surfaces reject anonymous callers with RFC 7807.
Account management requires a live JWT; API keys are deliberately not accepted.
The generated magic-link user is a regular user, so an admin route returns 403.

exec: pm.test(hasCookie ? '403 without CSRF' : '401 without a refresh cookie', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(hasCookie ? 403 : 401));

request.description: Run after 01 Auth so the dt_refresh cookie exists. Without the x-requested-with: trendr header the cookie-authenticated write is rejected.

header.description: CSRF header required while the refresh cookie exists

request.description: Includes the CSRF header because the refresh cookie from 01 Auth is present; without it the CSRF hook returns 403 before the token is checked.
Run after 03 Me revokes the key created earlier in the run.
Server-Sent Events. Postman buffers the stream until it is cancelled; the 25 s heartbeat keeps it open. Run manually in Postman; Newman would time out.

exec: pm.test('set unsubscribeToken from an email to exercise this', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 400, 401, 404]));
pm.test('previews the purpose', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.purpose).to.be.oneOf(['digest', 'alerts', 'all']); });

request.description: Requires a token from a digest or alert email. Set the unsubscribeToken collection variable; without it the request is expected to be rejected.

exec: pm.test('set unsubscribeToken from an email to exercise this', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 400, 401, 404]));
pm.test('confirms the unsubscribe', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.purpose).to.be.oneOf(['digest', 'alerts', 'all']); });

request.description: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe. Requires the unsubscribeToken collection variable.

exec: pm.test('admin JWT accepted or role rejected', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 403]));

request.description: Proves the admin-role JWT path. The generated magic-link user is a regular user, so this returns 403 unless you sign in with an ADMIN_EMAILS address. The Admin folder uses the admin-scope API key instead.

header.description: CSRF header required for cookie-authenticated writes

request.description: Revokes the refresh session and clears the dt_refresh cookie. Access JWTs stay valid until they expire.
The cookie was cleared by logout, so the refresh is rejected.
Deletes the throwaway Postman user and cascades its watchlists, alerts and keys. Run last.
